page.overview:
Who is Pharaoh Hotep?

2996 Adventurers Tomb 3021 King Pharaoh the Third 5958 Mummy's Tomb 5978 The Secret of the Sphinx 5988 Pharaoh's Forbidden Ruins 9377 Adventurers combined set 5703 LEGO Racers (Nintendo 64) 5704 LEGO Racers (PC) 5705 LEGO Racers (PlayStation) 5719 LEGO Racers (Game Boy Color) Soccer Mania

Pharaoh Hotep, also known as Pharaoh's Mummy, Pharaoh Ramses III, Pharaoh Ramses IV, and Eddie Elbow, is a minifigure in the Adventurers Desert theme, being first introduced in 1998.

Hotep has a dark green hip and black legs, printed with a green sash and grey toes. His torso is black, and printed with blue armor and a red-and-gold collar. His arms are black, and his hands bright red. His face is grey and printed with a smiling, stitched-up mouth, with skull-like nostrils and dark eyes outlined in red. On his forehead, above his eyebrows, is a scar which has been sewn shut. He wears a bright yellow nemes with blue and gold stripes printed on it. Notably, this minifigure's printed toes and nostrils are rare features among minifigures.

Pharaoh Hotep was buried in the Pharaoh's Forbidden Ruins, where his undead mummy guards the ancient Re-Gou Ruby and wards off anyone who tries to steal it.
